_comment: Researched 2026-11-19. Release: February 18, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC. Atlus announced the date at the Xbox Games Showcase in June 2026 (Gematsu, RPGSite, VGC). The Nintendo Switch 2 version follows on May 20, 2027, announced at the September 2026 Nintendo Direct (Gematsu, Game Informer). releaseDate uses the first launch. Revival is a remake that keeps Persona 4 Golden's story (Game Informer), so it includes the original game's culprit and twist names (Tohru Adachi, Taro Namatame, Mitsuo Kubo, Ameno-sagiri, Izanami, Kunino-sagiri, Marie) and the victims (Mayumi Yamano, Saki Konishi), which are canon from Persona 4 and P4 Golden. The Revival cast list and English voice cast come from the Persona 4 Revival Wikipedia article. Original Persona 4 and Golden names are in aliases, because their spoilers are this game's spoilers. Weak words: Rise and Kanji are English words. Yukiko, Naoto, Nanako, Adachi and Inaba are common Japanese names, surnames or real places. Marie, Margaret and Igor are common names (Margaret and Igor also appear in other Persona games). Izanami is a mythological goddess who also appears in other games. Junes, TV World and Investigation Team are generic. Every voice actor is weak. Accounts: none listed. Atlus_West is promoting the game heavily, but it also posts about Persona 6, Metaphor and Atlus's other games, so it does not meet the 'mostly this game' rule. Persona 4 Revival has no dedicated official X account that I could verify.
name: Persona 4 Revival
platforms: PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC (Feb 18, 2027); Nintendo Switch 2 (May 20, 2027)
